name: Dexelance S.p.A.
summary: Established in Milan, Italy, in 2015, Dexelance S.p.A. operates as a central platform dedicated to cultivating and promoting high-quality Italian-designed home furnishings. The company's diverse portfolio encompasses furniture collections from prestigious brands such as Gervasoni, Meridiani, SabaItalia, and Gamma Arredamenti International. It also provides innovative kitchen systems under its Cubo Design label, in addition to sophisticated lighting products from Davide Groppi, Flexalighting, and Axolight. Furthermore, Dexelance manages luxury furniture offerings from Cenacchi International and Modar. The firm, which was previously known as Italian Design Brands S.p.A., officially rebranded to Dexelance S.p.A. in May 2024.
